subject: expression: let `cast` function supports explicit set charset (#55724)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs parent with focus on expression/planner CAST+collation behavior. Change correctly plumbs `FuncCastExpr.ExplicitCharSet` into `BuildCastFunctionWithCheck`, adds a string-cast base builder that preserves explicit charset/collation in the builtin function’s collation metadata (important for pushdown via `expr_to_pb`), and updates CAST-to-string collation derivation to use connection charset/collation by default. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched planner/expression behavior; later upstream history includes a follow-up fix for a TiKV crash involving `cast(bit as char)` (#57484), so no outstanding High/Blocker remains attributable here.
